---
# The whole of a journal article's front matter, in typst and in the .pdf.
#
# Should: set the journal's masthead (logo, name, rule, copyright, issn,
# issue, doi), the title and byline, and the abstract, impact statement and
# keywords in the narrow block with the impact statement boxed, all across
# both columns; the author note, its ORCID lines set off, at the foot of the
# first column across both columns as asked; and the lists in the body.
title: "A Journal Article"
shorttitle: "Journal Article"
documentmode: jou
author:
  - name: Ann Author
    corresponding: true
    email: ann@example.edu
    orcid: 0000-0002-1825-0097
    affiliations:
      - name: Test University
  - name: Ben Author
    orcid: 0000-0002-1825-0098
    affiliations:
      - name: Other University
author-note:
  status-changes:
    affiliation-change: "Zqaffiliationchange."
  author-note-columns: 2
abstract: "Zqabstract text."
impact-statement: "Zqimpact statement."
keywords: [zqone, zqtwo]
journal:
  title: "Zqjournal of Things"
  logo: default
  issn: "1234-5678"
  url: "https://doi.org/10.1234/zq"
  copyrightnotice: "2026"
  copyrighttext: "The Authors"
  volume: 3
  issue: 2
list-of-figures: true
list-of-tables: true
format:
  apaquarto-typst: default
  apaquarto-pdf: default
---
